key_fiscal_facts.value_text: ~75-85% at 0-80/bbl (MET + export duty [zeroed 2024] + 25% CIT + NDD for enrolled fields). Pre-2024 tax maneuver completion: ~80-85%. Post-maneuver with export duty at zero but MET elevated: ~75-82% depending on field depletion coefficients and Urals discount. Sanctions environment complicates verification.
25% CIT (Nalog na Pribyl) from 2025 (raised from 20%). Applied to taxable income after deducting MET, export duty, OPEX, depreciation. No oil-specific ring-fence — consolidated return.

No royalty regime. Russia replaced royalties with MET (Mineral Extraction Tax/NDPI) in 2002. Effective MET rate ~USD 10-25/bbl at 0 Brent via formula: RUB 919/tonne * Kc * Kv * Kz * Kd * Kdv. See levy_met_rate.

0% formal equity participation in concession/MET regime. Rosneft (state-controlled via Rosneftegaz 70% ownership) accounts for ~40-45% of Russian crude production but holds equity as a commercial NOC, not under a fiscal participation clause. Sakhalin-2 PSA transferred to Sakhalin Energy (Russian entity) in 2022 — unique post-sanctions restructuring, not standard concession term.
